source_name: Adyen press release: Adyen launches embedded financial products
caveat: Adyen Accounts: embedded business accounts that platforms offer to their small-business users, live in the US and Europe from October 2022. Sold through platforms, not directly to small businesses.

source_name: Adyen: Embedded business accounts and card issuing for platforms
caveat: Adyen card issuing offered to platforms alongside embedded accounts. Undated product page; launch date not stated on the page.

Adyen terminals and in-person acquiring for enterprises and platforms; Adyen supplies terminals and acquiring, not a full POS software suite. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Adyen's core enterprise online acquiring. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Affirm: Affirm for merchants page (footer disclosures)
caveat: Affirm Money Account, a consumer deposit account held with Cross River Bank (Member FDIC); Affirm is not a bank. Consumer account, not a business bank account. Undated page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Affirm's core pay-over-time product for merchants (US page); the page cites 337K+ merchants. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Airwallex Bill Pay inside its spend management suite, paying vendors in 90+ currencies. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Airwallex corporate cards for employees and teams, issued locally in 60+ countries. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Airwallex's founding product: multi-currency business accounts (local accounts in 20+ currencies, transfers to 200+ countries). Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Airwallex Payments, online acceptance with local payment methods and local acquiring. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
BILL's core accounts-payable automation (ACH, check, card and international payments). Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

BILL Divvy Card, a company card with credit lines, issued through Divvy Pay's bank partners (Divvy was acquired by BILL). Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

International transfers as a payment option within BILL accounts payable; outbound payments, not multi-currency holding accounts. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Square Checking and Square Savings for Square sellers (US), launched as Square Banking in July 2021; Square Savings is held at Square Financial Services, Square's industrial bank.

source_name: Block: Block, Inc. completes acquisition of Afterpay
caveat: Block's BNPL line is Afterpay, acquired on 2022-01-31; the date is the acquisition close, not Afterpay's own launch. Covers the universe row 'Afterpay'. Square Online sellers in the US and Australia got Afterpay the same day.

source_name: Square: The Square Credit Card product page
caveat: Square Credit Card for US sellers on the American Express network, with credit limits set from Square processing volume; offers are invite-only for eligible Square sellers. Live (general application page) as of 2026-10-03; launched in beta 2023-06-28 (Block investor relations release of that date), which is the launch_date shown.
Square Point of Sale, Square's founding product line (US page). Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Square Online stores with built-in Square payment processing for sellers (US page). Square's online line is aimed at small sellers, not enterprise acquiring. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Brex payables, an accounts-payable product combining bill pay and purchase cards, launched 2023-08-01 as an upgrade; Brex offered ACH bill pay earlier (the 2019 Brex Cash release mentions 'ACH / Bill Pay'), and the first bill-pay launch date is not stated, so no launch date is shown.

source_name: Brex press: Brex launches new digital banking products for startups
caveat: Brex business account with Column N.A. as partner bank. The 2024-06-18 release describes updates to an existing 'flagship business account', so it is an expansion, not a launch. The release states that Brex's original business accounts launched in 2019 (Brex Cash, offered through a broker-dealer subsidiary); the 2024 release adds a Column N.A. checking account.
Brex's founding product, corporate cards with spend controls. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: PR Newswire (Brex): Brex announces launch of stablecoin payments
caveat: Announced 'upcoming' stablecoin payments (USDC) with a waitlist; general availability was described as 'in the coming months'. Recorded as announced as of the release date.
Checkout.com Issuing, card issuing for merchants announced at its Thrive event in London, March 2023; launch scope was the UK and Europe.

Checkout.com's core enterprise online acquiring; the home page also notes US direct acquiring going live. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Checkout.com newsroom: weekend settlement powered by Fireblocks
caveat: Stablecoin (USDC) settlement to merchants, using Fireblocks technology, unveiled June 2022 after a private beta; this is merchant settlement in stablecoins, not stablecoin issuance. Checkout.com extended it to US enterprise merchants on 2026-06-03.

source_name: Circle blog: Circle Payments Network mainnet is here
caveat: Circle Payments Network, a network for financial institutions to send cross-border payments settled in stablecoins; it serves institutions, not businesses holding multi-currency accounts.
USDC, the dollar stablecoin issued by Circle; Circle's core product. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Corpay accounts-payable automation. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Corpay Mastercard for travel and expense, purchasing and vendor payments, issued by Fifth Third Bank or another institution. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Corpay cross-border payments and currency risk management. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Clover POS systems for small businesses, owned by Fiserv. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Fiserv investor relations: Fiserv launches new FIUSD stablecoin for financial institutions
caveat: Fiserv group, not Clover specifically: FIUSD was announced on 2025-06-23 as planned for Fiserv's bank clients by end-2025, using Paxos and Circle infrastructure. The release announces plans; whether and where it went live is not covered by this row.

Flywire cross-border receivables for education, travel, B2B and healthcare: payers pay in local currency, clients settle in theirs. Collection service, not a multi-currency account. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: FIS press release: FIS completes acquisition of Global Payments' Issuer Solutions business
caveat: Global Payments exited issuer processing (formerly TSYS) when FIS completed its purchase of the Issuer Solutions business, announced 2026-01-12, alongside Global Payments' Worldpay acquisition. 'Discontinued' here means divested, not shut down: the business continues under FIS.
Genius point-of-sale system for small businesses and enterprises. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Merchant payment solutions for merchants and developers; since January 2026 the group also owns Worldpay, a large e-commerce acquirer. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Klarna investor relations: Klarna launches debit-first card across Europe
caveat: Klarna Card, a consumer debit-first Visa card that comes with a free Klarna Balance account, with optional pay-later; placed in this column as Klarna's consumer account product, not a business bank account. The release (2025-09-02, EU expansion) says the card launched in the US in July 2025; an earlier Klarna Card predates it in Sweden, Germany and the UK, so no single launch date is shown.

Klarna's core flexible-payment products for merchants (Pay in 4, Pay in 30 days, Financing), online and in-store. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Klarna investor relations: Klarna launches KlarnaUSD
caveat: KlarnaUSD, built on Bridge's Open Issuance (a Stripe company), was live on the Tempo testnet and not publicly available when announced; mainnet launch was planned for 2026. Recorded as announced as of the release date.

source_name: Marqeta investor relations: Marqeta announces Marqeta Flex
caveat: Marqeta Flex surfaces BNPL offers from lenders such as Klarna and Affirm inside payment apps; Marqeta does not lend. Announced as 'being developed' in October 2024.
Marqeta's core issuer-processing platform for card programs. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Bill pay and invoicing inside the Mercury account. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Mercury business checking and savings. Mercury states it is a fintech, not an FDIC-insured bank; deposits are held at Choice Financial Group and Column N.A. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Mercury credit card with 1.5% cashback and expense controls. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

International payments from the Mercury account; the page states no fees on USD payments only, so non-USD transfers may carry FX costs. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Company cards and expense management alongside Navan's travel booking business. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: PayPal newsroom: PayPal introduces Pay in 4
caveat: Pay in 4 (US), part of PayPal Pay Later; the date is the US Pay in 4 announcement, while PayPal Credit and other Pay Later products predate it. Covers the universe row 'PayPal Pay Later'.

PayPal Point of Sale, formerly PayPal Zettle (US page). The Zettle business was acquired, so PayPal's in-person line predates the current brand. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
PayPal checkout, card processing and Venmo acceptance for merchants (US page). Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: PayPal newsroom: PayPal launches U.S. dollar stablecoin
caveat: PayPal USD (PYUSD), a US dollar stablecoin issued by Paxos Trust Company for PayPal; PayPal is not the issuer of record. Initially for eligible US PayPal customers.
Payoneer multi-currency physical and virtual corporate cards. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Payoneer's core receive and send product across 190+ countries and territories. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Payoneer Checkout for accepting payments on merchants' websites; small relative to Payoneer's receivables business. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Ramp blog: Introducing Ramp Bill Pay
caveat: Ramp Bill Pay, accounts-payable software with approvals, announced October 2021 (US).

source_name: PR Newswire (Ramp): Ramp launches Ramp Treasury
caveat: Ramp Business Account and investment account (Ramp Treasury). Ramp is not a bank; deposits are held at First Internet Bank of Indiana.

Ramp's founding product, corporate cards with expense management; Marqeta's site quotes Ramp as a card-processing customer. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: PR Newswire (Ramp): Ramp simplifies how U.S. businesses spend and finance bills internationally
caveat: International bill payments and reimbursements for US-based Ramp customers (176 countries, 83 currencies at launch); outbound cross-border payments, not multi-currency holding accounts.

source_name: PR Newswire (Ramp): Ramp brings stablecoin accounts and payments to all customers
caveat: General availability of stablecoin accounts and vendor payments in USDC; the date is general availability, after a public beta.
Sezzle pay-in-4 over six weeks, online and in-store via a virtual card. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Shift4 POS and integrated payments for restaurants, hotels, venues and travel. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Shift4 investor relations: Shift4 launches global stablecoin settlement platform
caveat: Opt-in stablecoin settlement for merchants (USDC, USDT, EURC, DAI on several networks); merchant settlement, not issuance.

Shopify Balance, a financial account for US merchants with FDIC pass-through eligibility via partner banks; Shopify is not a bank. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: Shopify news: Shop Pay Installments launches in the U.S.
caveat: Shop Pay Installments is Shopify-branded but exclusively powered by Affirm in the US: Affirm, not Shopify, carries the loans. Read as a distribution partnership, not Shopify lending.
Shopify Credit, a pay-in-full Visa business card for Shopify merchants. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Shopify POS hardware and software with built-in payments. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Shopify Payments, built-in processing for Shopify merchants; the underlying processing partner is not named on this page. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

USDC acceptance on Shopify Payments via Coinbase (Base network) and Stripe; merchants receive local currency by default. Live as of 2026-10-03: the Shopify Payments page lists crypto among accepted methods from day one. The launch_date 2025-06-12 is the early-access announcement (shopify.com/news/stablecoins-on-shopify), not general availability; the general-availability date is not stated.

Stripe Treasury business accounts for Stripe users (the page says 'Open a bank account in minutes'), held through partner banks. Undated product page; launch date not stated on the page. The platform (embedded) version of Treasury predates this direct offer.

Stripe does not lend to shoppers itself; it offers third-party buy now, pay later methods (for example Klarna, Affirm) at checkout. Absence of an own-balance-sheet BNPL product is as of the date read.

source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe launches Stripe Issuing
caveat: Stripe Issuing, an API for businesses to create their own physical and virtual cards; available in the US at launch, by invite. Later geographic expansion is not reflected in this date.
Stripe Card, a Mastercard spend card drawn on the Treasury balance with 2% cashback; a debit-style business card, not a charge card with a credit line. Undated product page.
Multicurrency balances (USD, EUR, GBP shown) and payouts to 160+ countries inside Stripe Treasury. Undated product page; launch date not stated. Scope and currency list vary by country.

source_name: Stripe newsroom: Stripe announces Stripe Terminal
caveat: Stripe Terminal, a developer-programmable in-person acceptance product announced in the US in September 2018. Stripe sells readers and SDKs; it is not a full restaurant or retail POS suite. The current product page lists acceptance across 39 markets.
Stripe's core product: online card and alternative-method acceptance (the page cites 125+ payment methods). Undated product page; status is as of the date read. Launch date not stated on the page.

source_name: Stripe blog: Our top product updates from Stripe Tour New York
caveat: Stablecoin (USDC) payment acceptance in Stripe checkout, announced as available on 2024-10-09; trade coverage at the time described it as open to US businesses, settling in USD. Stripe later closed its Bridge acquisition on 2025-02-04 and announced stablecoin balances in Stripe Treasury in May 2025 with waitlist access. Current status is live.
Toast's core restaurant and retail POS with integrated payments. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

Toast Online Ordering for restaurants, processed through Toast; restaurant ordering channels, not general e-commerce acquiring. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Wise Business multi-currency account; Wise's core product. The page states 700,000+ businesses. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
Zip pay-in-4 in the US, online via a virtual card and in-store via digital wallet or the Zip Card. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

dLocal Payouts to staff, customers and partners in local currencies; cross-border disbursement, not holding accounts. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.
dLocal Payins: local payment-method acceptance for global merchants in emerging markets. Undated product page; status is as of the date read, and the launch date is not stated on the page.

source_name: dLocal press release: dLocal launches Stablecoin Full
caveat: Stablecoin Full: stablecoin collection, conversion and payouts across 44+ emerging markets; earlier stablecoin partnerships (for example with BVNK in 2025) predate it.
